probes.question: How high can you count on one hand in finger binary?

image.alt: A hand held up with all five fingers spread open, from a photo series of finger-counting hand shapes.

body.question: Using finger binary, where each finger is one binary digit, what is the highest number you can show on both hands?
body.reveal: 1,023. Each finger is a bit worth twice the one before: 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 on one hand. One hand alone reaches 31, and ten fingers reach 1,023.
